montrey_appraisal_hall.name: Montrey Appraisal Hall
montrey_appraisal_hall.canon: Grand gothic appraisal hall of House Montrey built from pale silver granite, towering stained-glass windows, polished marble floor, and glowing blue mana sconces.

blackwood_forest_clearing.name: Blackwood Forest Clearing
blackwood_forest_clearing.canon: Ancient secluded mist-shrouded Blackwood frontier pine forest clearing with towering dark ironwood trees, soft dark loam ground covered in pine needles, and a solitary six-foot moss-covered granite boulder sitting in the center. Pure isolated wilderness, fifty paces beyond the apothecary rear yard.

oakhaven_apothecary_courtyard.name: Oakhaven Apothecary Rear Courtyard
oakhaven_apothecary_courtyard.canon: Rustic rear courtyard directly behind Rowan Thorne's apothecary shop in Oakhaven. Features weathered cedar woodpiles stacked against the timber wall, soft dirt loam ground below low roof eaves, a low cedar picket fence, and a narrow worn footpath leading into the nearby evergreen Blackwood tree line.

rowan_apothecary_shop.name: Rowan Apothecary Shop
rowan_apothecary_shop.canon: Warm rustic frontier apothecary workshop interior on Oakhaven High Street. Cedar shelves lined with corked glass herb jars along North wall, stone hearth and iron skillet in Far-Left corner, polished heavy oak service counter at Center-Right, heavy oak front door bolted with iron bars on South wall, and a narrow wooden ladder hatch leading to sleeping loft in South-West corner.

oakhaven_apothecary_loft.name: Oakhaven Apothecary Loft
oakhaven_apothecary_loft.canon: Cozy wooden attic bedroom loft directly above Rowan Thorne's apothecary shop in Oakhaven. Sloping rough-hewn cedar rafters, small circular leaded translucent aperture on East wall overlooking distant green pine canopy and town roofs, simple straw mattress bed neatly made in North-West corner with thick wool blankets, small timber writing desk along South wall, wooden floor ladder hatch in South-West corner. Strictly isolated attic space.

white_dimension_library.name: The Infinite White Dimension Library
white_dimension_library.canon: Infinite pristine pearlescent white astral dimension left by the First Magicians, boundless polished white marble floor reflecting faint golden starlight mists, millions of colossal floating white-stone bookshelves and glowing ancient leather grimoires gently drifting in serene zero-gravity silence, absolute stillness, ethereal cyan arcane constellation rings rotating horizontally in distant white void.

oakhaven_perimeter_gate.name: Oakhaven Perimeter Gate
oakhaven_perimeter_gate.canon: Frontier wooden palisade gates of Oakhaven settlement reinforced with heavy iron bands, watchtowers with iron alarm bells, dirt road leading into dark Blackwood pines.

valerius_imperial_highway.name: Valerius Imperial Highway
valerius_imperial_highway.canon: Expansive temperate cobblestone and packed dirt imperial highway winding through rolling pine ravines and weathered grey granite boulders. Roadside milestone markers made of chiseled stone, clear daylight sunbeams cutting through green pine canopies, distant mountain ranges on the northern horizon. Temperate forest climate with zero snow.

highway_pine_ravine.name: Highway Pine Ravine
highway_pine_ravine.canon: Rugged rocky ravine passage flanking the Valerius Imperial Highway, surrounded by steep jagged granite cliff faces, towering dark pine trees, and massive mossy boulders suitable for ambushes and spellcraft testing. Broken stone terrain and coarse gravel loam underfoot with zero snow.

academy_courtyard.name: Imperial Arcane Academy Courtyard
academy_courtyard.canon: Expansive grand entrance courtyard of the Imperial Arcane Academy in Valerius, paved with pristine reflective pale silver granite and gleaming white marble. Flanked by multi-tiered gothic colonnades, crystal mana fountains emitting faint azure luminescence, and colossal arched entrance portals leading to the testing halls, with hovering ethereal cyan magic circles faintly visible above cathedral spires.

academy_resonance_hall.name: Academy Resonance Testing Hall
academy_resonance_hall.canon: Vast, monumental gothic testing chamber within the Imperial Arcane Academy built from pale silver granite and luminous mana sconces. High-vaulted ribbed ceilings, burnished dark-blue slate floors inlaid with concentric silver calculation rings, and towering stained-glass arched windows on the North wall providing an elevated panoramic window vantage over the soaring cathedral spires and hovering mana circles of the imperial capital. In the center stands the floating Arcane Resonance Crystal Pillar.
academy_resonance_hall.window_vantage: Panoramic view overlooking the pale silver cathedral spires, azure crystal pinnacles, and hovering cyan mana circles of the imperial capital.

academy_tactical_proving_grounds.name: Academy Tactical Proving Grounds
academy_tactical_proving_grounds.canon: Colossal open-air circular combat proving arena within the Imperial Arcane Academy, paved with interlocking reinforced silver-granite flagstones engraved with geometric ward lines. Enclosed by massive thirty-foot ancient runic barrier stones that project faint blue containment barriers during spell duels, surrounded by stepped stone spectator tiers, with clear sky above.

academy_lecture_amphitheatre.name: Academy Lecture Amphitheatre
academy_lecture_amphitheatre.canon: Monumental stepped circular lecture amphitheatre within the Imperial Arcane Academy built of pale silver granite and polished cedar student desks, vaulted ceiling with hanging brass chandelier sconces, and tall arched leaded stained-glass windows overlooking the pale silver cathedral spires and hovering cyan mana circles of the imperial capital.
academy_lecture_amphitheatre.window_vantage: Panoramic window view overlooking the pale silver cathedral spires, azure spire pinnacles, and hovering cyan mana circles of the imperial capital.

academy_private_dormitory.name: Academy Private Dormitory Chamber
academy_private_dormitory.canon: Quiet private stone student dormitory study chamber within the Imperial Arcane Academy. Pale grey ashlar stone walls, polished dark oak study desk with stacked grimoires along East wall, simple wooden bed frame with dark-blue wool blanket in North-West corner, dark timber floorboards, and a tall gothic lancet stone window on South wall looking out over nocturnal academy cathedral spires and moonlight.
academy_private_dormitory.window_vantage: Elevated window vantage overlooking nocturnal academy cathedral spires and hovering cyan mana circles beneath cool moonlight.

frozen_astral_crucible.name: Frozen Astral Crucible
frozen_astral_crucible.canon: Sub-astral trial realm deep within the White Dimension. Monumental frozen crucible of infinite translucent glacial ice sheets, colossal jagged frost crystal pillars radiating piercing azure chill, howling ethereal astral blizzard mists, hovering glowing frost runes, absolute stillness and freezing majesty.

ancient_labyrinth_corridor.name: Ancient Labyrinth Stone Corridor
ancient_labyrinth_corridor.canon: Monumental subterranean dungeon corridor of ancient moss-covered cyclopean stone blocks deep beneath the imperial bedrock. High vaulted stone arches supported by massive square pillars, pale-cyan luminescent crystal wall braziers casting cold subterranean shadows, damp stone flagstone floor with ancient geometric groove lines, branching dark corridors. Subterranean cavern with zero exterior windows.

labyrinth_50th_floor_sanctum.name: Labyrinth 50th Floor Sanctum
labyrinth_50th_floor_sanctum.canon: Monumental domed subterranean boss arena cavern of Floor 50 deep beneath the bedrock. Vast circular chamber surrounded by towering shattered obsidian pillars and ancient crumbled stone arches, cracked dark basalt floor inlaid with a colossal glowing azure and crimson circular runic boss seal, soaring stalactite-studded domed cavern ceiling with veins of glowing raw mana crystals, ethereal subterranean atmospheric mist. Subterranean cavern with zero exterior windows.
